info.title: Workspace Portal API
info.description: A Workspace gateway for PostgreSQL-compatible databases and File Systems. Workspace Keys authorize actions and resources; upstream credentials stay internal. Standalone MySQL and DuckDB databases are retired; DuckDB remains available for File System analysis.

put.summary: Create or conditionally replace Workspace tutorial progress
put.description: Requires an authenticated Workspace Owner session under the enabled account, Guest, or local/legacy profile. Region access Tokens cannot perform this Owner operation. One version precondition is mandatory (428 when absent). Creates return 201; replacements return 200. Failed or unknown acknowledgements must be inspected before proceeding. get.description: Required Region access Token scope: files:read. Resource operations also require the target in resourceIds (or an explicit wildcard). Lists are filtered to permitted resources. An authenticated Workspace Owner session under the enabled profile may also call this endpoint. Fixed CSV/Parquet schema/sample only: accepts resourceId/path, no custom SQL or engine settings. Requires files:read, not files:analyze. Whole version-verified snapshot up to 16 MiB, 15 seconds and shared two-worker budget; at most 20 rows, 50 columns, 128 KiB. post.summary: Run bounded read-only DuckDB SQL or Just Bash on one selected file
post.description: Required Region access Token scope: files:analyze. Resource operations also require the target in resourceIds (or an explicit wildcard). Lists are filtered to permitted resources. An authenticated Workspace Owner session under the enabled profile may also call this endpoint. Also requires files:read. Discover engines from capabilities: CSV supports DuckDB SQL over table file or Just Bash over its raw UTF-8 text. Bash exposes the selected absolute Workspace path; discover input.path, input.workingDirectory and compatibility aliases on its engine option. Paths refer only to the virtual selected-file snapshot. Parquet supports only DuckDB, and other recognized text only Just Bash. Only the selected snapshot is available; no provider credentials, network, persistent writes or host paths. Limits: 16 MiB input, 64 KiB script, 15 seconds, 1000 rows / 1 MiB output, two active analyses. Large/unsupported files remain downloadable. No implicit retry.

fileVersion.description: Saved-byte digest when supported; compare with tabular preview.

post.summary: Create a private destination-bound import review
post.description: Required Region access Token scope: queries:execute on destination; Workspace inputs also require source files:read/analyze. Resource operations also require the target in resourceIds (or an explicit wildcard). Lists are filtered to permitted resources. An authenticated Workspace Owner session under the enabled profile may also call this endpoint. CSV/Parquet only. Preparations are principal- and destination-bound, expire after five minutes, and retain at most 1,000 rows/100 columns/1 MiB parsed data. Preview returns at most 20 rows; commit uses all retained rows. Local uploads are ephemeral and never create a File System resource. Workspace inputs retain a 16 MiB snapshot budget. Parsing has a 15-second deadline and two slots. Existing 64 KiB SQL-statement budgets apply. Only server-generated DuckDB import writes have a fixed 30-second worker deadline per statement; ordinary SQL and parsing keep 15 seconds. New tables only; no append, overwrite, DROP or automatic write retry. Inspect the destination after an incomplete or uncertain outcome. Changing the target requires a new preparation. API restart invalidates preparations.

post.summary: Export a supplied result snapshot without rerunning its source query
post.description: Required Region access Token scope: Source database: queries:read (also implied by queries:execute); source File System: files:read and files:analyze. Destination additionally requires files:write or queries:execute and its resource grant. Resource operations also require the target in resourceIds (or an explicit wildcard). Lists are filtered to permitted resources. An authenticated Workspace Owner session under the enabled profile may also call this endpoint. Client-supplied snapshot, not attested provenance. Up to 100 columns, 1000 rows, 16 nesting levels and 1 MiB request. Downloads: CSV/JSON/JSON Lines, up to 4 MiB encoded output. Files: conditional create, 256 KiB local / 1 MiB live plus provider limits. Database targets: active live resources, CREATE then one INSERT, each up to 64 KiB and 15 seconds; no transaction across both statements. Name collisions never append/replace. EXPORT_INCOMPLETE or a timeout may leave a new table; inspect before retrying. No automatic retry. Precision strings remain text; CSV renders null as empty and prefixes spreadsheet-formula strings. No result values are audited.

post.summary: Execute one statement on a selected database; live SQL can read and write
post.description: Requires queries:read (implied by queries:execute) and the database grant. Writes additionally require queries:execute. Read-only mode is enforced for read-only Keys even when readOnly=false. The constrained read-only subset permits at most 1024 lexer tokens and 32 nested delimiters; unsupported syntax/functions fail closed.

readOnly.description: Enforced read-only mode. Automatically enabled for queries:read-only Keys.

sources.description: Reserved for the retired standalone DuckDB database capability; nonempty sources are not supported. Use File System analysis for DuckDB SQL over files.

name.description: Unique source table name in the per-query files catalog.

delete.summary: Request removal and retain an observable deletion tombstone
delete.description: Required Region access Token scope: resources:write. Resource operations also require the target in resourceIds (or an explicit wildcard). Lists are filtered to permitted resources. An authenticated Workspace Owner session under the enabled profile may also call this endpoint. Local removal completes synchronously (200). Drive9/DuckDB and PostgreSQL may return 202 with deletion.phase=provider-accepted or outcome-unknown. This is not proof of physical erasure. Drive9 completion is observed from provider status; PostgreSQL requires operator reconciliation. Zero returns 405 unchanged. No automatic retry or re-provisioning, including after restart. Deleting/deleted resources deny new data operations; admitted bounded downloads may finish.

guestOwner.description: Opaque regional Guest Owner session issued by POST /api/auth/guest when enabled.
